meta.title: Visual and Structural Prompt Injection in Medical RAG Systems: A Comparative Robustness Analysis
meta.venue: IEEE ICHORA 2026 (8th Int. Congress on HCI, Optimization and Robotic Applications)

problem.v: Local open-source medical RAG pipelines parse PDFs ignoring visual attributes, so hidden text can steer the model
problem.q: parsing gaps in the document processing layer

main_idea.v: Inject one fixed payload into PDFs via white text, 0.1 pt text and metadata fields; measure ASR on six local models with tracer keywords (septic shock, meropenem)
main_idea.q: visual-semantic mismatch (white-text), micro-typography, and metadata manipulation techniques

threat_model.v: Black-box attacker who can upload PDFs that a pypdf-style RAG pipeline indexes
threat_model.q: black-box threat model is adopted where the attacker does not have access

datasets_benchmarks.name: 100 synthetic discharge summaries (Gemini 2.5 Flash, 10 disease categories) -> 400 PDFs (100 benign + 300 infected)

metrics.name: ASR
metrics.definition: percent of outputs containing tracer keywords 'septic shock' or 'meropenem'

results.claim: Average ASR over 6 models x 3 vectors
results.q: manipulated with an average Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 47.78%

results.number: Gemma-3 96.33; Llama-3 61.00; Phi-4 56.00; MedLlama-2 35.33; Qwen-3 29.33; Meditron 8.67

results.q: Gemma-3 model exhibited the highest vulnerability with 96.33% ASR
Meditron-7B model, trained specifically for the medical domain, demonstrated superior resistance with 8.67% ASR

results.claim: No tracer keywords on clean documents
results.q: false positive rate for benign documents in all models was recorded as 0.00%

results.claim: Larger is not safer: Phi-4 14B vs Meditron 7B
results.q: assumption that larger models are safer is not valid for this type of attack

limitations_stated.v: NOT FOUND (no limitations section; future work lists visual sanitization and VLMs)

limitations_inferred: [INFERENCE] 2,400 = 6 models x 400 docs, so each ASR cell is one trial over 100 documents: no repeats, no CIs, no stated temperature or seed
[INFERENCE] Success = keyword present; a refusal or negation mentioning 'septic shock' would count as success (possible over-counting) and a paraphrased compliance would be missed
[INFERENCE] 'RAG' pipeline (retriever, chunking, vector DB) NOT FOUND; only pypdf-style text extraction is described, so retrieval may not be in the loop
[INFERENCE] Low ASR of Meditron may reflect weaker instruction following, not 'robustness'; no utility measured on clean documents
[INFERENCE] Single fixed payload and single task; Gemma-3 size/quantization, system prompt and runtime NOT FOUND
[INFERENCE] Domain-tuned vs general model comparison is confounded by family, size and fine-tuning recipe

reusable_for_our_project.v: High for our RAG app: PDF injection vectors (white text, 0.1 pt, metadata) are cheap and CPU-only; six open models of 7-14B are in our reach; tracer-keyword success check is deterministic. We add: multiple runs with CIs, stricter success rule, clean-task utility, and a sanitization defense (strip hidden text, flag tiny/white fonts, drop metadata) as in P04's sanitize/normalize

flags: Not comparable with P05 numbers (different benchmark, model and metric definition)
